batting.dismissal: c P Kumar b Z Khan

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c R Dravid b JH Kallis

batting.name: P Kumar
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b GD McGrath

batting.name: W Jaffer
batting.dismissal: c VY Mahesh b GD McGrath

batting.name: R Dravid

balls.text: moves outside leg, Praveen follows him with a full one and squeezed back to the bowler who puts his right hand out and makes a half-stop
the slower one from round the stumps, driven to long-off. A very fine over so far. All five balls from very shortened run up
slower one this time and its hit to midwicket
off five quick steps, he bangs it a bouncer, hooked to deep midwicket
off a very short run up - just a few paces, swings it into the batsman who swings it past square leg
yorker on the middle and leg, jabbed down the ground to long-on
down the leg side, tries to help it along but it runs off the edge, along the ground, to Boucher
Shot! fullish, outside off and elegantly driven to right of the mid-off fielder
slows up the pace, hit to deep midwicket for a single
yorker on the middle, from round the stumps, dug out in time
bangs it short, from over the wickets, and it climbs big on Gambhir who miscues his pull to Praveen at deep midwicket. A very fine innings comes to an end.
from round the stumps, on the middle, turned to midwicket
attempts a yorker, on the middle and drive to extra cover
tries a slower one but Gambhir picks it up early and drills it over Kallis' head.
fullish, just outside off, dabbed to the point region for a quick single
short in length, on the hips, swivels to pull it away to fine leg. He sort of lapped it around the corner
What a yorker! The off stump has broken into two pieces. It was right at the base of off stump and Karthik tried to bring down his bat in a hurry but was too late
takes a step to the leg sdie and drills a low full toss to left of long-off
short and outside off, steered to right of third man
short of length, on the stumps, pushed to the leg side

Gambhir moved to the leg side, Steyn fired it full and just outside off, Gambhir stretched across to slice but lost his bat at the point of impact! It slipped off his hand but the ball ran of the face of the bat to third man
slower one , flicked to deep square leg region. No ball and that means a free hit is coming up
on the hips, tucked to long leg for a single
Malik loses his middle stump. He moved outside leg and tried to run a short-of-length delivery to third man but was beaten for pace.
fuller, moves across to push to long-off for a single
Slap! Short of length, outside off and he just flat-batted it to left of Taylor at mid0ff
moves away to stab a yorker to left of point where Kohli dives to make the stop
slower one, mistimes a pull to Joshi at midwicket
short of length, outside off stump, dabbed to third man
from round the stumps, attempted yorker, jabbed to mid-on region

Dravid takes a stunning catch. No smiles, though. He just flings the ball in the air and walks briskly as the players mob him. Dhawan swung a full one across the line and Dravid dived to his right from his midwicket position to take the catch inches off the turf.
full in length, on the off stump line, driven to left of long-off
The runs refuse to dry up. Gambhir crouched and opened the bat-face deliberately to square drive to backward point boundary
gets his fifty this time, with a dab to the on side
Murder! It was full and straight, Dhawan swings it high and over midwicket. He raises his bat, thinking its fifty but he is on 49 actually.
full and on the legs, flicked to long leg for a single
another charge down the track and he flays along the ground to the cover boundary. Delhi are galloping away here.
As Tony Greig might have said, the white ball is flying everywhere. Gambhir waltzed down the track and lofted a flighted delivery over longon
comes down the track and flat-bats to long-off
Thinking Dhawan might come down the track, he bowls a really short one, Dhawan stays back to pull it high over midwicket. 200th six of the tournament
comes down the track, shortens the length and its driven to long-off
full, on the legs, gets a inside edge on a intended swing and it rolls to the 'keeper
fullish, on the middle and off, squeezed to point
full in length, Dhawan went for a cover drive but the bottom-hand came off the handle and the ball rolls to covers. Gauti walks across for a chat. Perhaps, its about the cheer girls
drifts on to the pads, tucked to fine leg
tries a slower ball but no luck. Gambhir waited on the ball and sliced the full one deliberately over backward point. Very well adjusted and played.
hurls across a full delivery on the off and middle, Dhawan pings long-on
reaches out to a full delivery outside off and driven to sweeper cover
pulls a short one to midwicket where  a half-stop is made and the ball rolls towards mid-on
driven to long-on for a single
again on that leg stump line - boy you can't bowl there - swung away to deep backward square leg region.
almost Chris Harris' action, on the leg and middle, flicked away for a single
seam-up delivery, on a length, around off, driven to long-off
another slower ball, outside the off stump, left alone
fullish and driven to long-on
a touch short of length, cut to backward point where Virat Kohli gets in a direct hit. Poor boy. It ricochets off the stumps for a single
shifts his line to the off stump, change in pace and driven to sweeper cover. 100 up in the 10th over
Again poor bowling. That leg and middle line again, on a driveable length and Dhawan swings it cleanly over square leg.
again on the leg side, swung to deep square leg region where Steyn kicks it away and Zak gets in with the throw
fuller, at normal pace and driven to long-off
short of length, pulled to midwicket for a single. It was the slower one from back of the hand.
short and rising this one and the surprise bouncer works. Gambhir tries to upper cut but fails to make contact
The punishment continues. Poor bowling continues. This one is on the leg side and Gambhir flays it to deep square leg boundary
almost caught at deep cover. It was a great effort from Steyn. Fullish, outside off and Gambhir had lofted it inside out over covers and in the air. Steyn rushed in, dived but couldn't reach it.
attempts a slower one but its too short and Gambhir kills it with a pull through midwicket
slower one, fullish and tapped to covers
charges down the wicket, Kallis shortens the length and Gambhir mistimes the shot to point
backs away to the legside and flays a length delivery to deep cover

short and rising outside off, it was going away from Dhawan who reached out to tap it high to the left of wide third man. It's a direct hit and they refer it upstairs but Dhawan was well in. The crowd roar their delight at the verdict
slower one, full and on the middle and leg, whipped to midwicket
full and outside off stump, square driven to point
fullish, driven to mid-off
from round the stumps, at the body, cramps him for room and he tries to dab it to the off side but can only dab it to the off side
low dipping full toss, on the middle, shovelled over midwicket
short in length, slightly slow too and he misses to connect with the pull shot and is struck on the pad. Going down leg though
full in length, on the stumps, driven to long-off
fullish, from round the stumps, driven to long-on for a single. "Bowled PK," is the cry from Boucher
shortish again, swilvels to pull it to deep square leg
short of length, cut to third man for a single. Dar is unhappy with Vinay Kumar stepping on to the danger area
mistakes keep coming. The previous one was short and outside off and this one is short and on the leg side. Easy pull and yet another easy boundary
slightly short of length, outside off stump and he cuts really hard at that. It races through backward point
Waits for the ball to come on to him and then deflects it fine to third man for a single.
On the pads, Gambhirs slugs hard, Down to fine leg where Zaheer dives and stops superbly. Two runs.
Kumar comes round the wicket. Bad idea. Too full, and Dhawan strokes it down to long-on for four. Lovely shot.
Played back down the pitch to the bowler, who collects on his follow-through
creates room for another cut, but again he can't pierce the off-side field. Good over so far
Bit of width, Dhawan cuts hard, but straight to Ross Taylor at point
Too close to cut, though Dhawan has a go. Bangalore need to pull this back now.
Praveen Kumar on. Gambhir plays one to short fine leg. Brisk single.

Gambhir plays it down to point and sets off. sehwag responds, but the pick-up and throw from Ross Taylor is brilliant. The umpire gives him out without even consulting the third umpire. Shikhar Dhawan is the new man in
gambhir pushes a length delivery to point, Kohli fields.
Sehwag makes room and cuts this one down to deep third man. Single. Neither bowler has looked especially dangerous
Sehwag clips Steyn off the pads for four. Empty spaces on the leg side.
This one is also played to backward point for a single
Gambhir angles the bat and plays it behind point. Steyn continuing here.
Sehwag makes room for another mighty flail but misses that one. Fortunately for him, it misses the stumps as well. No run. end of the over
another leg bye, with Zaheer once again on the pads.
Slants into Sehwag. He misses the glance, the the ball goes off the pad to short fine leg. One leg bye
Zaheer tries coming round the wicket. Imperious shot! Straight as a die down the ground. The Royal Challengers are taking a pounding here
Too short again, and this time Sehwag plays it finer, over square leg. Beats the man running in from fine leg.
Too short and far too easy. Sehwag flays that a long way over midwicket for SIX. The crowd are delirious, and why wouldn't they be?
Slants one across the left-hander. Gambhir thinks of going for it, but withdraws at the last moment. End of the over
Too full and too straight, and Gambhir clips that off the pads through midwicket for four. This is a bright start from the Daredevils who dare
Short ball pushes him back. Played defensively.
Bit of width and with the ball just sitting up, Gambhir crashes it through point for four. Super shot that. Gauti is on a roll here.
Gambhir taps it down on to the off side, but again Kohli is in quickly from point.
Short of a length, Sehwag pushes to mid-off. Zaheer shies at the stumps, and Sehwag dives to make his ground. That might have been close had it hit
Wide down the leg side. Steyn hasn't switched the radar on yet.
On the pads again, and Gauti doesn't miss out on those. Again, not much more than a push through midwicket. Four more.
The boundaries have started coming. Too much width, and nice even bounce. Calmly cut away past point for four more.
Eased through midwicket, lovely shot. Too straight from Zaheer and Gambhir cashes in.
Squirted out to backward point, Gambhir thinks of a single, but Virat Kohli, the local boy, is on to the ball quickly
Bit of width outside off stump, Sehwag cuts it to third man. Another single. Didn't quite get hold of that.
Gambhir takes a step down the pitch in anticipation, but decides to angle the bat and play the ball to third man instead.
Just wide of off stump, Sehwag has a flirt. No contact, perhaps just as well. He was beaten for pace
Slants in to him, played to short mid-on. Another well-run single
Short of length, pushed to the off side
Too straight, clipped off the pads to deep backward square leg for a single
Just short of a length, Sehwag punches off back foot to point. No run
on the off stump, pushed to short cover for a quick single
down the track and he mistimes a swing past midwicket. The Daredevils have won and the Challengers sink again.
came down again, Sehwag pushed it well outside off, Boucher reaches out to find the straight boundary
Gets the six this time. He charged down the track, took it on the full and swung it over midwicket.
swings it hard but straight to deep midwicket.
full and driven to long on
dropped by Bhatia and what's more its a six. Boucher had swung a full toss hard and Bhatia jumped but ended up palming it behind him
The armer takes out Kallis. He ran down the track, had a heave but missed. He was through the shot early.
a quicker one now - Vettori is mixing up things rather nicely-  Boucher, down the track, gets a inside edge to fine leg
takes the pace off the delivery and Kallis can only loft it one bounce to long off
quicker one, slog swept to left of deep midwicket but Dhawan makes a fine stop rushing across in time
walks down the track and heaves it to long-on.
comes down the track, Vettori takes the pace of the ball and Boucher flat bats a drive back to Vettori who makes a half stop
slower one, short of length, Boucher was early into his pull but manages to drag it behind square leg
low dipping full toss, shoveled to right of deep midwicket where McGrath makes a tumbling diving stop near the ropes. It's referred upstairs and the verdict is that its a legit save.
mistimes a heave to long on
the yorker ends up as a low full toss and Kallis drills it straight down the ground. That was hit really hard. 50 up for Jac
slow yorker, falls short of the blockhole and Kallis whips it in the air, past the diving McGrath at midwicket.
slower one, on the pads, Boucher can't connect - he is yet to get going here - and it runs off the pad
just a single to long-off.
fuller, outside off, Boucher goes for a sliced drive, gets an outside edge and the ball flies to right of third man
short of length, outside off, cut to point. super over this
in the zone outside off, Boucher tries to dab it through point, gets an inside edge that takes the ball behind the stumps.
full pitched and driven to long off for a single
starts off with a lovely yorker on the leg stump line, Kallis just about manages to bring his bat down to keep it out. Almost dragged back to the stumps as well.
low full toss and Boucher punches it past midwicket and to the boundary. McGrath is angry with himself; kicks the ground, snatches the cap and walks away. Nothing has changed. What a guy.
stays back to punch a length delivery to midwicket
full, driven through the off side

McGrath takes his fourth wicket. Dravid moved outside leg, McGrath hurled it outside off, on a length and Dravid ended up skying his lofted drive and Sehwag, running in from covers, took the catch. This is the best figures by a bowler in this tourney. McGrath becomes the first bowler to take four wickets. what a legend
goes for the yorker, falls just short of the blockhole, driven to long on
slower one, Kallis misses a offdrive and KArthik, standing up to the stumps, gathers
quicker one and Kallis gets it to mid-off region for a single
Dravid backs away to the leg side but Vettori keeps his cool and sends a slower one, loopy one on the middle and Dravid stretches forward to loft it in the air, one bounce to long-off
turns it to midwicket region
arm ball outside off stump, quick one and Kallis misses the cut shot
full and on the leg stump line, Dravid first tried to go forward, then back and ended up mistiming it down the track

Kallis goes down on his knees to propose - dispose rather a flighted delivery over midwicket. Sehwag collects his cap from the umpire and really had a go at him! This was , I suppose, for the lbw appeal earlier on but that had struck him outside off.
again pretty full in length, whipped to right of long on
backs away to the leg side to push a yorker-length delivery to cover point. Good tight over this.
floats it full, Kallis misses the sweep shot but was just struck on the pad, just outside off stump.
pings the long off now
full and driven to longon
That shuffle again and he turns a full delivery outside off to right of midwicket. Kallis has deployed this technique of walking across the stumps a lot tonight.
Imperious and classy.  It was full and outside off and leaned across to unfurl a cover drive.
fuller and outside off, yorker length and Kallis misses a square drive and the 'keeper collects
shuffles across outside off to flick a length delivery, misses but it runs of fthe pads to fine leg boundary
just outside off, another length delivery, Dravid attempts a late cut but doesn't get it fine and will pick a single to third man
on a length, on the off stump, Kallis waits, opens the bat-face and guides to third man
Kallis goes for a sweep, misses and it runs off the pad to the leg side
goes for a reverse sweep now but misses the quicker delivery completely and they take the bye
shimmies down the track, reaches the pitch and lofts it over wide long on.
shuffles outside off and wrists it past square leg, they think about two but decide against it
fuller, outside off, drives hard but straight to MAlik
spins in towards the hip, Dravid goes back to play it with the turn to backward square leg
full and straight, steered to point, Dravid wanted a single but Kallis turns down the request. Wise decision as it went straight to the fielder
leg cutter outside off but Kallis just stood tall and knifed it on the up through cover point. Again, like Dravid, he waited a touch to find that placement
fuller, on middle and leg, wristed to right of midwicket
Oh nice adjustment. It was a slower one but slightly short and that allowed Dravid to wait on the ball before cutting it through point
full and outside off and Dravid leans across to play an elegant cover drive.
slower one, outside off, pushed to extra cover
lovely late cut. It was full in length, moving towards the off stump when a crouched Dravid opened the bat-face to guide it through vacant slip region.
stays back to punch a length delivery to deep cover.
leans forward to drive through the off side
picks up a leg bye now. again that walk outside off and he misses to connect with an intended glance
waist-high full toss, on the off stump and its pulled away to midwicket boundary, one bounce over the ropes
driven to long-on
mistimes a cut to extra cover
flighted on the middle, paddled on short fine leg
short again and cut hard to point
just outside off and nudged to point
the arm ball but short of length and Dravid rocks back to pull it very hard and to the midwicket boundary
on a length, just outside off, again straightens , dabbed back down the track
again that walk to outside-off and he then turns a length delivery past square leg
on the middle and leg, Dravid let the ball come to him before wristing it to fine leg
bouncer and Kallis pulls it down to the ground and to deep midwicket region
short delviery, pulled to deep midwicket. Free hit coming up
short in length, Kallis stands tall to get on top of the bounce to fist it away to deep cover
flighted delivery on the middle, it dips rapidly and Kallis squeezes it to short fine-leg region
slower, loopy flighted delivery and Dravid leans forward, opens the bat-face to guide to point
Dravid backs away a touch to cut a straight delivery to covers
slightly short and punched to sweeper cover
goes back to push a length delivery that turned ever so slightly to covers
short delivery on the off stump, pulled to long-on for a single.
short in length, outside off and punched to sweeper cover
walks across the stumps and nudges a length delivery to mid-on for a quick single
creamed through the off side. Full in length but width offered outside off and Kallis went back to hit it on the up to the point boundary
walks to the off stump, Mahesh keeps it on the outside-off line and Kallis gets a inside edge on to the pad
short of length, on the off and again it straightens, Dravid gets his first run with a dab to the off side. He was out for two consecutive golden ducks in this tournament
lands on a length, on the off stump and straightens, Dravid defends down the track

McGrath gets his second wicket of the over. Again banged in short, bit of extra bounce and that's enough to do the damage. Jaffer messes up his pull shot - he was on the front foot too - and sends a dolly to mid-on
full pitched, on the leg and middle, mistimes a on drive to mid-on
short in length, coming in towards the hips, tucked behind square leg
bangs it in short and Jaffer is late on the pull but it falls short of deep midwicket
Taylor's IPL stint ends. Full and on the middle, he again went for his leg side swing and ended up miscuing it to deep midwicket. He is a such a fine player but keeps going across the line
fuller on length on the off stump, Taylor stands tall and drives it on the off side for a boundary. Good shot that
fullish, on the middle and leg stump line, Jaffer leans forward to play a lovely lofted on drive over long on. Very nonchalantly done.
shuffles to the off stump and on drives a dipping low full toss to midwicket
yorker on the off stump, jabbed back to Asif
even fuller, on the leg and middle, tries another heave, misses and it runs off the pad. That was close.
Full and on the off stump, Taylor gives it the almighty heave across the line and gets a nice little profitable edge to third man. Cue for the tv comms to go, "it doesn't matter how it comes ....
driven towards cover
fulltoss outside the off stump, Taylors goes across the line, fails to connect properly - diving stop from Sehwag at midwicket saves couple of runs
short of a good length delivery and Taylor hooks it away to fine leg - a flat six
worked away through square leg
forced away to covers - bit of hesitation going for the single but in the end Jaffer made it across comfortably
worked away off the back-foot to the midwicket region, quick single called for - Jaffer was a goner had Sehwag hit the bowler's end stumps
Once again Asif strays on to the pads and Taylor happily flicks it away to the fine leg fence - easy pickings
short ball outside the off stump, a half hearted pull - some may call it a controlled pull. Easy single to deep square leg
good length delivery outside the off stump and Taylor drives it down to mid-off
too full and on the pads, Taylor leans forward and clips it away behind square leg for an easy boundary
line and length delivery, forced away towards point
Taylor swing across the line and the ball zips past the outside edge - he has scored lots of runs playing that shot in this tournament
short delivery outside the off stump, Taylor sways back and pulls it away towards midwicket - not a well timed shot but the ball goes wide of the fielder and they scamper through for a single

that the end of that! good length delivery on the middle and leg stump line, Kumar looks to work it over the in-field on the leg side but only manages to the find Dhawan at the edge of the circle - soft dismissal.
short delivery, Kumar ducks under it but leaves his bat hanging over his head and the ball runs away off the edge to the fine leg region
bit wide outside the off stump, no shot offered
but this time he connects - similar line and length and this time the swing makes contact and the ball flies away to the extra cover fence
good length delivery outside the off stump, hint of away swing - Kumar has a swing at it and the ball goes through to the keeper - he is already looking like a fish out of water
